description: Tunnels burrowed toward the world's lava. Cross the Bone Bridge, get past the Hatchery's broodguards, and face the Elder Dragon on its hoard. Recommended level 27.

actions.text: The tunnels fall quiet, but the vents keep spitting fire.
The pools settle. The Bone Bridge lies ahead.
The wyverns are down. Warm air rolls out of the Hatchery.
The broodguards fall. The nest is yours to tend, and the hoard waits to the north.
A small cache glitters among the coins.
The Elder Dragon falls. Its hoard is yours.

name: Wyrm Hollow
